scope.real_Data_initializations: Read existing frozen graph/vector material only; no model generation.
scope.supervisor_child: One actual harmless Python subprocess per suite run; writes a synthetic reply and marker, never imports the live worker.
scope.authorization_testing: The worker authorization hook is stubbed for synthetic success fixtures; a denial fixture proves it runs before credential loading. Actual authorization/readiness manifest validation remains part of final live preflight.

nonblocking_warnings: Pinned LanceDB emits DeprecationWarning for table_names(); no request or credential data was printed.

findings_resolved.problem: A fully JSON-unicode-escaped synthetic credential survived byte/string replacement and appeared in normalized response content after decoding.
findings_resolved.fix_by_parent: Recursively redact decoded JSON strings and normalized response structures; sanitize JSON/SSE private body copy when decoded strings contain the active credential.

findings_resolved.problem: response_bytes was measured after redaction (330 received bytes misreported as 309), without identifying the saved body as changed.
findings_resolved.fix_by_parent: Record original received length, stored_raw_bytes, raw_redacted and raw_byte_exact separately.

findings_resolved.problem: Redaction could shrink an over-cap reply enough to mark raw_complete=true despite response_byte_cap_exceeded.
findings_resolved.fix_by_parent: Compute raw_complete from original received length and the original cap.

findings_resolved.problem: SSE with a legal leading keepalive comment was not recognized by raw sanitization, retaining an encoded synthetic credential recoverable from the private body.
findings_resolved.fix_by_parent: Use Content-Type text/event-stream or any data: line to select SSE sanitization, including leading comments.

verified_invariants: Raw body file exists, is fsynced by implementation, mode 0600, and provenance checkpoint exists before decode is called. Reasoning is present only in the synthetic private raw test fixture and absent from normalized/public-candidate response and diagnostics.
Headers are not copied into envelope; only allowlisted Content-Type category and status are retained. Literal and decoded Unicode-escaped synthetic credentials are redacted.
Authorization, ledger status/synthetic flag, supervisor PID, request directory, body hash and official schema validation run before the fake credential loader or HTTP opener.
One O_EXCL marker is consumed per reservation. Existing reply returns unchanged; a consumed marker without reply rejects rather than dispatching again.

A decoder interruption after the raw/provenance checkpoint leaves a reply that prevents another worker send. Invalid UTF-8 and raw-path symlinks cannot trigger a second send or overwrite the symlink target.
The Request uses frozen probe.HOSTS HTTPS endpoint, POST, unchanged body and 120s generation/30s embedding timeouts. Certificate validation and hostname checking are enabled; redirects reject.
HTTP authentication errors retain fixed categories and private raw evidence, not arbitrary error text. TLS failures retain transport_security_error; connection timeouts retain their fixed category.

Real runner.load_legacy().Data() preserves probe.supervise, probe.HOSTS and probe.load_credential identity. Both runner.Runtime and legacy.Runtime bind the new bounded module; runner.Transport binds the new transport.

After real Data initialization, actual probe.supervise launches the intended new transport.py worker argv; a substituted harmless child completes through the real supervisor and yields request_dispatched=true.
remaining_boundaries: No real service dispatch was made. Synthetic transport tests are software safety/compatibility evidence, not evidence that the six historical failures are solved.

Power-loss behavior was covered through durable-marker and interrupted-checkpoint states; this is not a physical disk/power-cut experiment. Ledger recovery and cumulative budget review are separately owned.

Private raw bodies can include service reasoning and other sensitive source material. They must stay in the ignored private run directory; only a separately reviewed allowlist export may be published. Credential substitution is not a universal detector for arbitrary secrets.
Final live-readiness must bind these final hashes and the independently reviewed new bounded/auth/inheritance files before a real dispatch.
summary_zh: 独立离线审查发现并复测通过4项修复。27项测试通过，确认raw先落盘、单次发送门禁和中断不重发，且真实Data初始化未污染supervisor或新执行器导入路径。没有真实API或凭据读取；历史6次故障的真实根因仍不能从此合成测试推定。
